seo_description: Book your bridal party, birthday or corporate group. Group perks, private Golden Hours and custom packages.
hero_intro: Celebrating something special? Book your group and let us pamper everyone in true Polished style, with group perks, private Golden Hours, and custom packages.
hero_note: Now booking holiday parties, office team outings & bachelorettes for November–December.
steps: On our booking page, select the Services tab.
Select the option that fits your guest size.
Book your appointment to reserve your spot.
steps_note: Book at least 1 week ahead (2–3 weeks for weekends and December).
perks_intro: The bigger the party, the better it gets. Every guest who books a hand service and a foot service unlocks your group's perks.

tiers.name: Groups of 4–5
items: A welcome toast for every guest (21+)
A collagen hand mask for everyone
5-hour validated parking for every guest who spends $100+ in cash

tiers.name: Groups of 6–7
items: A free matte, jelly, or special top coat upgrade for every guest
Free nail art (up to $15 value) for the guest of honor

tiers.name: Groups of 8+
items: An extra 5 minutes of massage for every guest
Golden Hour fee waived for private early or late bookings

perks_fine_print: To qualify, each guest must book a hand service (manicure or nail set) and a foot service (pedicure). Group size counts qualifying guests only. The welcome toast is for guests 21+ and served during business hours only. Parking validation applies to guests who spend $100+ in cash. Perks have no cash value.
golden_hour: Want the salon to yourselves, or need us beyond our usual hours? We'll open early or stay late by request. A Golden Hour fee applies for extended or private timing.

policies.title: Confirmation
policies.body: After you book, our team reaches out within 24 hours to confirm. Requests aren't guaranteed until confirmed.

policies.title: Payment & gratuity
policies.body: A credit card holds all group appointments, with a deposit to secure your reservation. The balance is charged on the day of your booking. Advance payment may be required for services totaling $80+ per guest. A 20% gratuity is added to all group bookings, calculated on the full service total, and goes directly to your nail artists.

policies.title: Cancellation & changes
policies.body: We ask for at least 48 hours' notice for any change, including guest count. With notice, your deposit carries to your new date. Within 48 hours, your deposit is retained. No-shows may be charged up to 50%.

policies.title: Running late
policies.body: Let us know as soon as you can and we'll do our best to accommodate. Shortened services due to late arrival are charged at the scheduled rate.

policies.title: Food & drink
policies.body: Light food and drink are permitted with advance notice for standard bookings. Anything is welcome for private events.
